title: She’s a Trump acolyte. He’s a ‘gringo Sandinista.’ Meet the Harps.
summary_full: Trump aide Natalie Harp is estranged from her brother, Preston, who has used social media and recent interviews to criticize her and highlight his own left-wing politics.
